subject: planner: remove the default implementation of exhaustPhysicalPlans of all ops. (#64011)
summary: This change is a mechanical refactor that removes now-unused `ExhaustPhysicalPlans` methods from several logical operators, `memo.GroupExpression`, and a test-only mock logical plan, updating core call sites to invoke the corresponding standalone functions instead. The physical plan enumeration still funnels through `core.exhaustPhysicalPlans`’ type-switch (and cascades via `memo.ExhaustPhysicalPlans4GroupExpression`), and the underlying enumeration implementations/function-pointer wiring remain unchanged; no plausible correctness/semantics regressions (Blocker/High) were found in the touched planner paths.
